{"code": "# Now, define the target population: NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
# This means: channel == 'paid_search' AND customer_segment == 'new'
target_group = df[(df['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (df['customer_segment'] == 'new')]

# Check the size of the target group
print(f"Total in target group: {len(target_group)}")

# Compute the conversion rate: fraction of converted orders in this group
conversion_rate = target_group['converted'].mean()
print(f"Conversion rate: {conversion_rate}")"}
